title: fix(review): a peer-review clone must not inherit the driver's route Stop hook
description:
# 🌙 dream: a peer-review clone must not inherit the driver's route Stop hook

kind · reseed · owner: ehmpathy/rhachet-roles-bhrain (route guard + `rhx enroll`) · caught 2026-10-06

## .the cue that fired

stone `5.1.execution.from_vision` of `.behavior/v2026_09_26.fix-blocklist-nudge`, rounds i011 and i012:

- i011 `enroll-impl-arch-defects`: the clone ran `route.stone.set --as arrived`, was refused
  (`clone enroll depth budget spent`), then asked its caller "Which do you want?". the tallier read
  the lane names r10/r11 in that prose as 2 blockers (F28)
- i012 `enroll-impl-behavior-intent`: the clone finished a clean review at T+6m
  (`0 blockers, 2 nitpicks`), then `rhx route.drive --when hook.onStop` fired ~8 times. each reply
  refused to drive. the LAST reply became the stdout the guard read: no count lines → `💥 malfunction`

## .the gap, precisely

an l3 peer lane runs `rhx enroll claude … -p '<review prompt>'` in the same worktree. the clone
boots with the worktree's route bind, so the driver's `route.drive` Stop hook fires inside the
reviewer. the guard reads the clone's final message, not its review.

evidence: `rhx clone get @:13cebcf0 --tail 60` (the i012 lane), and the i011 r011 given.

## .the shape of the fix

either:

1. `rhx enroll` (or the guard that spawns a peer lane) marks the clone as a reviewer, and
   `route.drive --when hook.onStop` exits 0 in silence for a reviewer clone; or
2. the guard captures the reviewer's first message that carries both count lines, not the last
   message

option 1 fixes the cause; option 2 only makes the symptom survivable.

## .why it is not done in this round

the hook and the enroll live in rhachet-roles-bhrain / rhachet, not this repo. this route works
around it in its own guard: each l3 prompt tells the reviewer to answer any Stop hook with its full
labeled list and the two count lines.
